name: stop_fill_repurchase_20261031
comment: ANCHOR: STOP_FILL_REPURCHASE_20261031 — a FILLED broker stop observation is settled by the trade ledger (its
order id in trade_transactions.description): fill -> re-buy or a later holdings refresh is history, never
'awaiting holdings sync'; an unsettled fill says what it waits for and since when; a working order outranks a
filled one on the same read. Operator 2026-10-31 (V stopped and re-bought). Synthetic tickers; no DB/network.
